hook: Is falling perplexity just more code in training?

beats.say: OpenAI published a chart of its models' perplexity dropping over time, pitching perplexity as a universal measure of intelligence. A footnote reveals it was measured on a fixed corpus of code.
Blogger micjm found a paper that trained the same 160 million parameter model on five data mixes, varying only how much was code.
With 75 percent code, perplexity on code fell, but on non-code text it rose sharply. The point: the chart needs far more qualification.
